sloka: यद्य् एतत् अशुभम् कर्म न स्म मे कथयेः स्वयम् ।फलेन् मूर्धा स्म ते राजन् सद्यः शत सहस्रधा ॥२-६४-२३॥
transliteration: yady etat aśubham karma na sma me kathayeḥ svayam ।phalen mūrdhā sma te rājan sadyaḥ śata sahasradhā ॥2-64-23॥

translations.english: 'O king, hadn't you yourself broken this inauspicious news, your head would have split into a hundred thousand pieces right now.
